decision_rule: The number of directions holding 95 percent of the spread in the per-count average vectors, at the chosen readout, must reach 4 at one or more of the probe windows 140, 200 and 280. Staying at 3 or fewer at every window is DIMENSION_BELOW_4, which extends the 410-million-weight result. The counts at 90 and at 99 percent are recorded beside this and carry no threshold.
metric: Directions holding 95 percent of the spread in the per-count average vectors, at the chosen readout, per probe window.
notes: The counting convention is the smallest number of directions reaching 95 percent of the spread, which is the gate record's answer 1 and every prior run's convention. The same counts at 90 and at 99 percent are recorded above and decide nothing; the reading uses 95 only. The threshold of 4 is the design's own guess, motivated by about 6 directions in the published pattern against 1 to 3 in the 410-million-weight model. If the floor gate recorded in these values failed, this record is void as evidence about the model, and is an instrument fault only. A further run of this script on the same box is a rerun of the same instrument, not a replication.
